Definition
[The tensors $P$ and $M$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0287, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0288 1. ch15:eq-15.5,eq-15.9\group Harnack Quadratic

For a Ricci flow at time $t>0$, define \[ P_{kij}= abla _kR_{ij}- abla _iR_{kj} \] and \[ M_{ij}=\Delta R_{ij}- rac12 abla _i abla _jR +2R^{\ell }{}_{ijp}R_{\ell }{}^p-R_i{}^pR_{pj}+ rac1{2t}R_{ij}. \] Then $P_{kij}=-P_{ikj}$ and $P_{ijk}+P_{jki}+P_{kij}=0$.
Proof

\sketch The skew symmetry is immediate from the definition. The cyclic identity is the sum of the three displayed differences; every covariant derivative of the Ricci tensor occurs once with each sign.

□
